column1: # TITLE: Microarray analysis of lung cancer cells gene expression in overexpressing different semaphorin 5a domains
# SUMMARY: Semaphorin 5A (SEMA5A) is one member of semaphorin family
column2: which was identified as an axon guidance molecule in nervous systems. In our previous studies
column3: SEMA5A was identified as a prognostic biomarker for lung cancer in nonsmoking women and acted as a tumor suppressor gene in inhibiting the proliferation and migration of lung cancer cells. Yet
column4: the regulatory mechanism of SEMA5A was not clear. Therefore
column5: the purpose of this study was to explore the roles of different domains of SEMA5A on the tumor suppressive effects in lung cancer cell lines.
